exposure: Guidance on breastfeeding during the prenatal period
outcome: Compliance with the fourth step of the Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative
Breastfeeding in the first hour of life
cohort: 107 mothers who had recently given birth
finding: The study found a low compliance rate (9.3%) with the fourth step of the Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative (skin-to-skin contact for at least 30 minutes after birth), with cesarean section being negatively associated with compliance.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was negatively associated to infant skin-to-skin contact with their mothers immediately after birth.
